entries.title: Psalms 130:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Out of the depths do I call upon thee, Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 130:2
segments: Lord, hear my voice; let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication.

entries.title: Psalms 130:3
segments: If thou, Jah, shouldest mark iniquities, Lord, who shall stand?

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
segments: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 130:5
segments: ¶I wait for Jehovah; my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

entries.title: Psalms 130:6
segments: My soul [waiteth] for the Lord more than the watchers [wait] for the morning, [more than] the watchers for the morning.

entries.title: Psalms 130:7
segments: Let Israel hope in Jehovah, because with Jehovah there is loving-kindness, and with him is plenteous redemption;

entries.title: Psalms 130:8
segments: And he will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
